result.rationale: The diff shows EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents now calls createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId) once per destination/credential, and CalendarManager passes credential.id. But packages/lib/CalendarService.ts createEvent still destructures only `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and filters calendars by that single externalId — for a non-main-host credential, the filter yields no calendars and Promise.all([]) creates nothing while returning success. Similarly office365calendar and larkcalendar services only read destinationCalendar[0].ext

Similarly office365calendar and larkcalendar services only read destinationCalendar[0].externalId, so a second host's credential would target the main host's calendar. This mechanism is fully visible in the diff and is a real correctness defect.
